findings: moveFileOrDirectory deletes existing destination before rename/copy, ignoring destination removal Boolean. Failed source read/copy can therefore leave preexisting destination removed. Not an atomic replace/rollback operation. No real move/delete or failing filesystem probe executed.

Move fallback copies recursively/file overwrite then deletes source based on copied Boolean/destination existence, no byte/content verification or stable source observation. Partial source deletion returnsfalse despite some files removed; partial destination not rolled back. Same absolute-path string guard is not canonical/inode equality and no subtree-cycle guard shown.

Paste copies overwrite existing paths without conflict resolution in helper. Dialog/menu callers still unread, so do not assert globally absent overwrite warning. copiedFiles snapshotted inside coroutine, isMoveOperation read repeatedly rather than captured; clipboard may change if UI allows concurrent actions. On move it clears copiedFiles even with failures.

Generic renameFile only calls renameTo then refresh/load lists; stored favorites path not updated, so old path can disappear when loadFavorites checks exists. Image/audio album rename migrates pinned path, image also locked path; child favorites and last-played path not migrated here. Same path is location reference, not durable object identity.

performDelete counts actual LocalTrashManager successes and reports movedCount, rather than all targets as success. Entry deleteFiles stages filesToDelete; confirmation UI still unread. Progress/selection cleared and loaders refreshed; exception/finally handling outside perfile manager remains unqualified.

Compression writes directly to currentDirectory/zipName, opens FileOutputStream before walking inputs; existing target can be truncated, partialarchive retained on exception. Output inside selected directory can become input without explicit exclusion here. No archive produced.

Compression recursive empty/null children both represented as emptydirectory entry; unreadable directory may be represented as empty, silently losing coverage. No symlink/cycle/depth/work cap in zip walker. Duplicate entry names across selected roots can fail after partial write.

Extraction combines output folder with entry name without canonical containment validation, explicit no-overwrite policy or total-byte/entry-count bounds. Defensive requirement is validated destination containment and bounded output before publishing. No crafted archive, payload, or extraction executed.
shareFiles uses explicit FileProvider content URIs plus read-grant flag and ClipData for every URI; triggers chooser only on user action. No outgoing share/message or external app invoked in review.

Permission gate renders guide rather than mainviews when permission absent, narrowing v72 concern: loaded lists retained in state are not directly mainview-visible in this branch. Actual dialog/overlay gating later source pending.

Album lock path management is UI-path based; rename migrates known markers. Request unlock handles biometric success/PIN fallback. Storage/encryption/global action policy not certified by this fragment; no bypass claim or test.
